summary: Read comics added from your computer or Komga library.
page_description: Read CBZ comics on your Kobo with zoom, spreads and right-to-left reading. Add comics over USB or download them from your Komga library.
release_notes: Move page and a rotated page's controls fit the panel, and reading options are switches. Check for comic says when no volume.cbz is there, the shelf shows a new reading direction at once, and Back from the copy guide returns to your comics.

steps.text: Choose Try a sample comic to read offline. CBZ files up to 32 MB are supported; CBR and PDF are not.
To send comics from your computer, set up the reader once over USB, if you have not already.
Send one or more comics. Each push adds to what you sent before, and Panels puts them on its shelf under their own titles the next time you open it.
To use Komga, choose Browse and enter your HTTPS server address. Add your username and password in Account details, then check the connection.
Open Download on your shelf to retry a paused transfer. A completed download can be added to the shelf offline; saved comics remain available.
